verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Personnel API endpoints, a general claim of monitoring personnel, and a community note that people in the corporate directory appear as noncompliant in the Drata dashboard. That is adjacent personnel tracking. Nothing documents HR/HRIS sync, onboarding or offboarding checklists, training completion tracking, or proof that leavers lost access.

support.subject: As an IT admin, onboarding and offboarding are compliance events — HR-synced checklists prove every hire got training and every leaver lost access
